opportunities.title: Henry Moore Grants

amount.raw: Category maxima: £20,000 (New Projects & Commissions; Acquisitions & Collections; Long-Term Research); £5,000 (Conferences, Lectures & Publications); £2,500 (Research & Travel)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK and international non-profit organisations (New Projects & Commissions, Acquisitions & Collections, Conferences/Lectures/Publications, Long-Term Research); individual sculpture historians, academics and conservators (Research & Travel). Applications considered four times per year.
opportunities.summary: Grants supporting the growth and development of sculpture across historical, modern and contemporary registers, and research expanding appreciation of sculpture. Funds exhibitions, exhibition catalogues, commissions, conferences, research, non-commercial publications, and collection development (acquisitions, conservation, cataloguing, display). Autumn round currently open; future rounds: Winter opens 1 Nov 2026 (closes 1 Dec 2026), Spring opens 1 Feb 2027 (closes 1 Mar 2027), Summer opens 1 May 2027 (closes 1 Jun 2027).

opportunities.title: Visiting Research Fellowships

amount.raw: Expenses allocation for travel and subsistence: UK up to £600, Europe up to £700, Rest of world up to £1,000; plus accommodation in Leeds or Hertfordshire

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Academics, curators, artists and established scholars researching historic and contemporary sculpture. Artist Research Fellowships for artists; Senior Fellowships (six weeks) for established scholars.
opportunities.summary: Month-long fellowships enabling artists and researchers to develop their work using facilities at the Henry Moore Institute in Leeds or Henry Moore Studios & Gardens in Hertfordshire, including accommodation, travel and subsistence. Applications currently closed for 2026/27; next round opens in spring 2027.

opportunities.title: Dissertation Prize

amount.raw: £250 cash prize each for BA and MA dissertations, plus Henry Moore Institute publications to £50 cover price value

opportunities.eligibility_summary: BA and MA students of all disciplines who submitted a dissertation within the past academic year at a UK university, relating directly to sculpture.
opportunities.summary: Two annual prizes for outstanding extended writing on contemporary, modern or historical sculpture. The 2025 prize closed; submissions for the 2026 prize are stated to open in autumn.
